title: bromopsis erecta
intro: Bromopsis erecta, commonly known as Upland Brome, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family, Poaceae. The health benefits of Upland Brome include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Bromopsis erecta include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which may help to calm the nervous system and relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
